notes.title: Update adding new content
notes.notes:
This rather major addition, adds a chapter about Sakari and her past, in addition to a message from the developer that can be read.

The addition of new achievements and the creation of a better and more ergonomic menu 

Don't forget that episode 2 of Godland: The Fire Quest is coming on October 31, 2022 we count on your support and hope you will enjoy it.

notes.title: Second Update
notes.notes: This update corrects all the spelling mistakes and updates the main menu of the game, rearranges the text placement, adds a more efficient option for changing the language and adds a Linux version

notes.title: Godland : The Fire Quest release date !
notes.notes:
Godland : The Fire Quest will be released on May 31 2022. Hope you'll enjoy the game.
